question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution:
The correct answer is: **'When'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Point__**

__
 
• The most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2 is: **'When'.**
 
• The word** 'When'** is an **Adverb** used to suggest time.
 
 
• **Example**: *W**hen did you last see him?*
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is:** 'Option 1'.

Correct Sentence__**: Many parents think of overweight children as 'cute' and cuddly. However, obesity must not be (1)__ seen __as a healthy sign. (2)__ **when**__ obese children grow up, they will be more prone (3)____________ health problems like high blood pressure (4)________ diabetes. Today, overweight children are becoming a common (5)___________ in many countries.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2**: **'****Then**' means at that time.
 
• **Option 3**: **'****Here'** means in this place.
 
• **Option 4**: '**There**' means in or at that place.
